chapter: Thomas, own bands and neighborhood clubs
title: Playing with Buddy Petit; no early records
summary: Barnes played often with Petit and Kelly but recalls no recordings before his late ones.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: My first record date: sessions, personnel, discography

blocks.x: Did you play with Buddy Petit any in these years, Moody?
Oh yeah, I played with Buddy, Austin. I mean a whole lot with Buddy. There wasn't no recording though. No, I don't remember no recording.
Yeah the band that was on the same order Chris Kelly's, was you say? Yeah. Some kind of thing.
No. I don't remember making them.
When did you make your first record? I don't know.
I don't know when I'm in the first record. I couldn't, never get my head about that now.
You make any records with anybody else in town or just with your own?
No, no. I don't think I remember making any records to all outside of Hill.
That's like a late year since you'd known me, huh?
Well, I'd say pretty much that. Yeah, pretty much that.
Because you recorded for Alden and David, that's the first one I knew about.
